analysis: The PR only modifies CHANGELOG.md (documentation). The patch adds a new 'Unreleased - Autopilot target preflight' section at lines ~49-52 saying an Autopilot load whose target failed its startup self-test or has no weight hash is now refused before any resident model is unloaded. This describes an availability/robustness improvement (fewer stranded models) and a fail-closed preflight; no source code, authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or data-exposure logic is in this diff. No threat-model assumption (TB-002, TB-009, TB-011, T-052..T-058) is invalidated by the changelog text. Caveat: the actual code implementing the preflight is not supplied, so its correctness (e.g., whether a missing weight hash is refused consistently with the fail-open weight-hash behavior described in TB-002/SEC-007) cannot be assessed; the next pass should examine the corresponding Autopilot command/load path if included in other batches. Note the changelog says the weight hash being absent now refuses Autopilot loads, which is stricter than the fail-open admission policy but only for coordinator-initiated Autopilot loads; no regression apparent. No findings.
